changes: Aligned serve-facing documentation and fallback hints with the real lattice serve surface, including CLAUDE.md, packages/main/src/verifier/dev-cli.ts, and packages/main/src/verifier/serve.ts. Refreshed the framework audit so B-META-framework-audit F-012/F-013 are resolved.
usage: Users should read the serve examples directly in CLAUDE.md and rely on lattice serve / lattice serve --help for the supported flags; if the core is missing, the fallback prompt now tells them to start lattice serve.
expectedOutcome: A reader sees only supported serve invocations (`lattice serve`, `lattice serve --dev="npx vite"`, `lattice serve --port=N`) and the framework audit no longer reports the serve doc drift.
actualTranscript: CLAUDE.md now shows the supported serve surface only; the fallback prompt in packages/main/src/verifier/serve.ts now says lattice serve; lattice audit round 9 reported 0 still-drifting items and resolved B-META-framework-audit:F-012/F-013; validate and npm test passed.
outcomeDiff: Expected and actual now match; the only extra step was refreshing evidence after a later fallback-hint fix.
limitations: The dev-cli.ts implementation still retains compatibility parsing for `--web` / `--cli`, but those flags are no longer advertised in user-facing docs or hints.
pitfalls: Keep the serve surface and all fallback text in sync; reintroducing npm run serve or phantom `--web` / `--cli` examples would reopen the same class of drift.
